Definition
[radial distance function in exponential coordinates]

Source: petersen:page-0207 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-short-geodesics-segments

On $U=\exp _p(B(0,\varepsilon ))$ let $r(x)=|\exp _p^{-1}(x)|$, the Euclidean distance from the origin in $B(0,\varepsilon )\subset T_pM$, continuously extended by $r|_{\partial U}=\varepsilon $. In Cartesian coordinates on $T_pM$, $\nabla r=\partial _r=\tfrac 1rx^i\partial _i$.
